Name: Shopkeeper Leela Way Back Pelican Town Medieval Recolor
Author: apollo10145
Description:
What it is: A recolor of[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39490] Shopkeeper Leela's[/url] store, to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url] by Gweniaczek. 

How to install: unzip the folder and drag and drop into your /mods/ folder, allowing it to rewrite the assets.

Please let me know if you have any issues!

Bus in screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24873?tab=files]Seasonal Cozy Bus[/url] by KiwiSprinkle

Downloads.Description: Unzip and place into your mod folder, remember to rewrite the files.
